Sessions that break off before checkout are the ones that buy nothing, and a checkout page changes how many sessions get that far, so a rise measured over the sessions that arrived is consistent with purchases across the whole segment holding flat. All four segments are desktop sessions from Canada via search inside March and the same quarter drops out of each, so no case in the log supplies what the others leave out.
items.notes: SEED. Cases identical to coherent_true; only the closer differs. The discount works as a single confound precisely because all four segments share the same month.
